sloka: अन्तरिक्षे च भूमौ च सर्वे स्थावरजङ्गमाः ।दानवाश्च महाकायाः पाताले पन्नगाधिपाः ।। ७.९७.२५ ॥
transliteration: antarikṣe ca bhūmau ca sarve sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ।dānavāśca mahākāyāḥ pātāle pannagādhipāḥ ।। 7.97.25 ॥

translations.english: All stationary and moving beings in the sky and on the earth, along with the huge-bodied demons and the lords of serpents in the netherworld, were present.
